rounds.text: The bear case rests heavily on the contraction and severe deceleration of the company's underlying earnings engine over medium-term horizons [E19]. Specifically, compounded profit growth over 5 years has dropped to -3%, demonstrating a stark inability to convert its historical top-line expansions into sustained bottom-line delivery [E19]. Even over a compressed 3-year window, compounded profit growth limps along at a meagre 4%, which badly lags the broader sector median profit growth of 22.0% [E20, E72]. This chronic weakness in profitability expansion has directly infected shareholder returns, resulting in a flat 3-year compounded share price growth of 0% [E24]. Furthermore, long-term share price appreciation sits at a pedestrian 7% over 10 years, reflecting structural investor skepticism despite steady top-line growth [E14, E22]. Conceded: the company maintains a trailing twelve-month profit growth of 7% and trades at a P/E of 15.1x, which offers some near-term fundamental support [E1, E21].
